chunks: Jamil narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم cursed the one who commits an offense in al-Madinah or shelters an offender,
I said, "And what is that offense?" He said, "Killing."

key_terms.الْقَتْلُ: Killing; identified here as the offense in question
key_terms.بِالْمَدِينَةِ: In al-Madinah, the sacred city mentioned in the narration
key_terms.مُحْدِثًا: An offender who has committed such a violation

ai.seo_question: What offense in al-Madinah is identified in this hadith as bringing the curse of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم cursed anyone who commits a grave offense in al-Madinah or gives protection to such an offender. Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام explains that the offense meant here is killing, highlighting the severity of unlawful bloodshed and aiding those who perpetrate it.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.5156 - Jamil narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
"The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) cursed the one who commits an offense in Medina or shelters an offender."
